FN-6P9V13-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 221
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/24/2023
Senate Bill 221 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Genetic Counseling Fund by
an undetermined amount dependent upon the amounts awarded by the State Board of Genetic
Counseling to qualified individuals, institutes, or agencies to promote genetic counseling
programs and continuing education programs for licensees. In addition, this bill could decrease
the obligations of the Board by estimated $2,800 annually per meeting by allowing the
9-member board to meet electronically.
